response.overview: After the enormous success of You Are Always Nearby, Simonova presented her next piece, titled Don't Be Too Late!, at the final of Ukraine's Got Talent. It's an autobiographical work where the artist speaks about her relationship with her parents and her regret for not having spent time with them while they were alive. A poignant story about parental love, it ultimately won the competition.
response.title: Don't Be Too Late!
